prompt: Create a vertical 9:16 cinematic VHS-style fashion photograph of a young woman seated on a small Parisian balcony café terrace above a narrow wet city street after rain. She has soft denim blue, shoulder-length tousled wavy hair with airy flyaways, pale skin, delicate features, and a calm slightly melancholic expression as she looks up toward the camera. Shoot from a high, close, wide-angle perspective, as if the photographer is standing over her on the balcony; her body is turned sideways on a bentwood café chair, one hand resting at her waist. Dress her in a pale blue-gray long-sleeve blouse tucked into a flowing high-waisted pleated skirt, creating a soft monochrome blue-gray outfit. Include exactly 2 visible café furniture pieces: one round metal café table on the left foreground and one woven rattan café chair at the lower left. The balcony has a weathered stone railing, and beyond it are classic Haussmann-style buildings, a narrow reflective street, parked cars, and moody overcast backlight. Use desaturated cool tones, film grain, slight motion blur, lens vignetting, subtle chromatic aberration, imperfect analog focus, and a nostalgic 1990s camcorder look. Add white vertical VHS on-screen display text: at upper left, a small play triangle with “PLAY” and the timecode “00:08:17”; at lower left, “AM 11:23” and “JUN 13 2024”. No extra people, no modern signage emphasis, no watermark, keep the image photorealistic and atmospheric.

promptZh: 创作一张 9:16 竖屏电影感 VHS 风格时尚摄影作品，画面中一位年轻女性坐在雨后巴黎狭窄潮湿街道上方的小型阳台咖啡露台上。她留着 柔和牛仔蓝、及肩凌乱波浪卷发，带有轻盈的碎发，皮肤白皙，五官精致，抬头看向镜头时表情平静且略带忧郁。采用高机位、近距离、广角视角拍摄，仿佛摄影师正站在阳台上俯拍她；她的身体侧坐在曲木咖啡椅上，一只手放在腰间。为她穿上一件浅蓝灰色长袖衬衫，束进飘逸的高腰百褶裙中，打造出柔和的单色蓝灰色造型。画面中包含 2 件可见的咖啡家具：左侧前景处的一张圆形金属咖啡桌，以及左下方的一把藤编咖啡椅。阳台有风化的石栏杆，背景是经典的奥斯曼风格建筑、狭窄且带有倒影的街道、停放的汽车以及阴郁的背光。使用低饱和度冷色调、胶片颗粒感、轻微运动模糊、镜头暗角、细微色差、不完美的模拟对焦，呈现 90 年代怀旧摄像机的质感。添加白色 VHS 屏幕显示文字：左上角为一个小的播放三角形，旁边标注“PLAY”和时间码“00:08:17”；左下角标注“AM 11:23”和“JUN 13 2024”。画面中不要出现其他人，不要强调现代标识，不要有水印，保持照片的真实感与氛围感。
